title: Tensor pullback transports a presentation over a specified open
statement: Let g:X→Y be a morphism of ringed spaces, G an O_Y-module, and V an open of Y. If G.over V has a global free presentation p, then the concrete tensor pullback of G, restricted over the specific inverse-image open g⁻¹(V), admits a global free presentation. There is no quasi-coherence hypothesis and no unspecified neighbourhood.

source.place: Lemma 17.10.4, global presentation step, applied to the restricted morphism g⁻¹(V)→V

proof.text: Put F = Opens.map g and U = F(V). The functor Over.post F from the slice over V to the slice over U is continuous: F is representably flat, hence preserves finite limits; Over.post F preserves finite limits, hence is flat, and cover preservation descends to slices. It is final because it preserves terminal objects. Restrict g-sharp to obtain the concrete slice-site ring map.

Compare F composed with Over.star U and Over.star V composed with Over.post F using the inverse of the product comparison of F. Pushforward composition and pushforwardCongr₂ give an isomorphism between direct image after the right adjoint of restriction over U and the right adjoint of restriction over V after slice direct image. For the ring maps, compose structure-sheaf restrictions along the product comparison and the second projection; prodComparison_snd reduces this to the naturality identity of g-sharp at prod.snd. Thus the comparison respects scalar actions.

Choose the concrete tensor functor and its adjunction furnished by the underived theorem. Compose this adjunction with the restriction adjunction over U. Compare with restriction over V followed by the slice module-pullback adjunction. The preceding right-adjoint isomorphism and Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq identify these left adjoints. At G, transport along the prescribed object equality of the tensor functor to obtain the isomorphism from slice pullback of G.over V to the displayed concrete tensor pullback over U.

The slice module pullback is a left adjoint and therefore preserves colimits. Since Over.post F is final, Mathlib pullbackObjUnitToUnit is an isomorphism. Apply Presentation.map to p with the inverse unit isomorphism, and transport its presentation through the comparison with Presentation.ofIsIso.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 17.10.4; restriction comparison implemented by uniqueness of left adjoints and the product comparison on opens

lean.statement:
theorem tensorModulePullback_presentation_over
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
    (p : (G.over V).Presentation) :
    Nonempty
      (((SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf G)).over
          ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g.hom.base).obj V)).Presentation)
